summary: The single design unit DESIGN-001 implements longest_word exactly as requested, with precise contract, error condition and boundaries. Unit tests TEST-001..007 have concrete expected values and cover normal, tie, single word, whitespace and ValueError cases; system tests TEST-008/009 cover all five acceptance criteria. No integration specs are needed since there is one component and no interfaces.

checklist.note: split() + max(key=len) is straightforward and tie behaviour matches the design.
Pre/postconditions, ValueError condition and boundaries are specified; non-str input deliberately out of scope (ASM-002).
TEST-002 distinguishes first-vs-last on ties; TEST-004 detects whitespace inclusion; TEST-005/006/007 cover empty, whitespace-only and single space.

checklist.item: System specs cover every acceptance criterion
Nothing designed that is not requested

checklist.note: Constraint without acceptance criteria; verified by code review at G4.

findings.description: The postcondition 'return value is an element of text.split()' is not asserted separately, but TEST-001..004 return exact values, so it is covered indirectly.

integration_applicability.reason: One component (ARCH-001) with a pure function; no interfaces, no integration specs; G6 not applicable.
